items.title: USS George Washington heads to Middle East after record 265-day Lincoln deployment
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported Thursday that the USS George Washington, based in Japan, is heading to the Middle East to relieve the Lincoln as part of a previously scheduled rotation. The George Washington transited the Strait of Malacca alongside guided-missile destroyers this week, according to open-source tracking data cited by the Journal.

items.title: Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII) Stock Could Be 33% Undervalued Following New Submarine Contracts
items.summary: Huntington Ingalls Industries stock has delivered a 77.0% return over the last five years, yet both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples still point to the shares trading at a discount to what the business may be worth. That combination puts the recent share price near US$326 into focus for investors who care about what they are paying for each dollar of future cash flow.
